title: Higher direct images of an injective module sheaf vanish
statement: Let $p:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, let $R$ be a commutative ring, and let $I$ be an injective object of the category $\Mod(X_{\Et},R)$ of sheaves of $R_X$-modules on the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then the higher direct images of the underlying sheaf of abelian groups vanish: $R^qp_*I=0$ in $\Ab(S_{\Et})$ for every $q>0$, where $R^qp_*$ is the higher direct image of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-direct-image].

source.place: Lemma Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree): $H^q(U,I_{ab})=H^q(U,I)$, which is $0$ for $q>0$ because the restriction of an injective module to $U$ is injective; Lemma Tag 072W (lemma-higher-direct-images): $R^qp_*I$ is the sheafification of $V\mapsto H^q(X\times_SV,I)$

proof.text: Write $I_{ab}$ for the underlying abelian sheaf of $I$ and, for an object $U$ of $X_{\Et}$, $H^q(U,-)$ for the derived functors of $G\mapsto G(U)$ on $\Ab(X_{\Et})$. By [lem-weil-pbc-higher-direct-image-sheafified-presheaf] applied to $p$ and $F=I_{ab}$, for each $q\geq0$ the sheaf $R^qp_*I_{ab}$ is canonically isomorphic to the sheafification of the presheaf $P_q:V\mapsto H^q(X\times_SV,I_{ab})$ on $S_{\Et}$.

Let $q>0$ and let $V\to S$ be etale. Then $X\times_SV\to X$ is etale (base change of an etale morphism), so $X\times_SV$ is an object of $X_{\Et}$, and by [lem-weil-pbc-injective-module-abelian-acyclic] applied to the injective $R_X$-module $I$ and $U=X\times_SV$ we get $H^q(X\times_SV,I_{ab})=0$. Hence $P_q(V)=0$ for every $V$: $P_q$ is the zero presheaf for $q>0$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03FD (lemma-cohomology-modules-abelian-agree), second paragraph of the proof

proof.text: The zero presheaf is a sheaf, and a morphism from it to any sheaf is the zero map, so it satisfies the universal property of its own sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]: the sheafification of $P_q$ is $0$. By the first step $R^qp_*I_{ab}=0$ in $\Ab(S_{\Et})$ for every $q>0$, which is the claim.
